confidence_notes: Restaurant estimates draw on recent local price indexes, which disagree on beer prices; wine is estimated near the local draft-beer price. Accommodation is a holistic estimate based on the supplied city comparisons.
comparable_city_reasoning: Catania is a year-round Sicilian city with tourism demand. I place basic lodging near Lecce and three-star lodging somewhat above Lecce, while keeping both below the supplied Sorrento and Como prices and generally below Rome.
